disease_label_per_paper: Disseminated gonococcal infection with arthritis-dermatitis syndrome
presentation_summary: 27-year-old healthy woman with allergic rhinitis presented with 4 days of fever, sore throat, painful skin lesions, myalgias, and unilateral wrist, elbow, and ankle pain.
She reported unprotected oral and vaginal sex with one partner over the prior 6 months and denied dysuria, urethral discharge, or genital lesions.

Examination showed sparse erythematous pustules on the palmar fingers, a necrotic papule on the third digit, left ankle inflammatory signs with pain on passive and active motion, left plantar extensor tenosynovitis, and right arm flexor tenosynovitis.
Vitals were BP 127/72 mmHg, pulse 82/min, respiratory rate 16/min, temperature 39 C, and SpO2 100% on room air.
Labs showed WBC 12.89 x10^3/uL with 73.6% neutrophils and CRP 69.8 mg/L; ultrasound showed moderate left ankle effusion and surrounding edema.
